probes.question: On what date did the Global Freelancers Association release the report saying the gig economy is burgeoning and reshaping career perspectives?
verbatim: A report released on October 5, 2023, by the Global Freelancers Association (GFA) indicated that the gig economy is not only burgeoning but is also reshaping career perspectives.

probes.question: According to Bureau of Labor and Economics data as of November 2023, what share of the U.S. workforce is involved in some form of freelance or gig work?
verbatim: According to data from the Bureau of Labor and Economics (BLE), as of November 2023, roughly 36% of the U.S. workforce is involved in some form of freelance or gig work.

probes.question: Why has employing freelance experts enabled TechFin Innovations to stay agile, according to CEO Emily Torres?
probes.answer: Because it employs freelance experts on a project basis, which lets the company stay agile and innovative.
verbatim: Employing freelance experts on a project basis has enabled our company to stay agile and innovative.

probes.question: Which topics does the document say are being debated in the policy conversation about freelancers and make headlines?
probes.answer: Healthcare, retirement benefits, and employment rights
verbatim: As debates on healthcare, retirement benefits, and employment rights make headlines, one thing remains clear: freelancing is sidestepping the conventional narrative of what it means to work.
